notes: How each cast member looks and holds their eyes in conversation (ConversationPerformance). Cosmetic only: no wording, story, clinical or save effect. Faces are the cast-standard expression morphs, already authored at in-game intensity. gaze_breaks: seconds between short looks away while they speak ([] for none). beat_seconds: after you make a choice, how long they look down and gather themselves before their reply (0 for none). Patients keep a neutral face while speaking and never avert their eyes or pause, so nothing reads as a symptom; Naomi is acted by NaomiActingController and is not listed.
